svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Annotated bibliography, literature matrix, synthesis (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, DOI checking, the research question the run needs [D24, O, AD11, AV15]; a research report and its bibliography [AV1]; the profile [AV2]; a file in words [AQ] (stop); Literature strategist, once: review.md, refs.bib, a .bib patch when a .tex is given; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5; it does not start without a research question [D48, D2, AD11, AV15, AV16] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Script: apply the .bib patch [D48] (script); Script: reference checks [D48] (script); Draft writer: reference-fix, once [K] (ruled); Script: reference checks again, failures left named [K] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); End (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
